goal: Progressive, durable weight loss without injury or exhaustion, after a sedentary period.
injuries_or_limits: none known; stop on joint pain
history: Month 1 (14 Sep - 11 Oct 2026): return to exercise. 4 sessions a week plus a walk and 2 rest days, rower steady and intervals, HIIT progressing from 6 x 20 s / 90 s to 8 x 40 s / 50 s. The user did more HIIT efforts than prescribed every week (9, 12, 15, 12), so the HIIT was too easy.

Month 2 (12 Oct - 8 Nov 2026): HIIT baseline of 12 efforts, progressing by effort/rest ratio and intensity instead of adding reps (12 x 40 s / 50 s, then 12 x 45 s / 45 s), rower intervals 5-6 x 500 m and 4 x 750 m, Saturday strength circuit. Benchmark 20 min steady row at RPE 5 planned on 12 Oct (no result recorded). Ill from 26 Oct to 1 Nov, partial week 2-8 Nov, back on track from 9 Nov; HIIT 12 x 45 s / 45 s repeated on 4 Nov and 11 Nov.
